name: Elder Darkcore
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Darkcore keeps watch in the throne room above the Undercity. He honors the world's ancestors and blesses travelers who come to pay their respects.

sections.title: A Spirit in the Throne Room
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, ancient elders appear across Azeroth to share their wisdom with travelers. Elder Darkcore keeps watch in the throne room of the Ruins of Lordaeron, directly above the Undercity entrance. King Terenas Menethil II fell on the blood-stained floor there. Those who enter the heart of Forsaken territory to pay their respects receive a Coin of Ancestry and his blessing.

faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Darkcore appears as one of the honored ancestral spirits. In the throne room above the Undercity, he gives visitors blessings and Coins of Ancestry.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Darkcore?
faq.answer: Elder Darkcore waits in Capital City's ruined throne room, in the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity entrance.

faq.q: Is Elder Darkcore hostile to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Elder Darkcore is neutral and welcomes travelers who come to honor him. Alliance visitors must evade hostile guards patrolling the Forsaken stronghold in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

faq.q: What does honoring Elder Darkcore give you?
faq.answer: Paying respects to Elder Darkcore earns a Coin of Ancestry.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you must slip past high-level Forsaken sentries and royal guards around Capital City's ruins to reach Elder Darkcore. That makes him one of the festival's most perilous stops for you.
As an Undead, you find Elder Darkcore only steps from the Undercity's surface elevators, on the very stones where the kingdom of Lordaeron was torn down.
